html:
The empire built by the Tijani scholar Umar Tall from Futa Toro, who began a jihad in 1852 and conquered the Bamana kingdom of Segou in 1861 and the Massina Empire in 1862.

His army, armed with guns bought from the coast, swept across the upper Senegal and Niger. The French under Faidherbe blocked him in the west at Medine in 1857. A revolt in Massina followed, and Umar died near Bandiagara in 1864. His son Ahmadu ruled from Segou until the French took it in 1890. The empire spread the Tijaniyya order widely in West Africa.
sum: The empire built by the Tijani scholar Umar Tall from Futa Toro, who began a jihad in 1852 and conquered the Bamana kingdom of Segou in 1861 and the Massina Empire in 1862.
